title: sse: fix streaming chunking/framing for partial JSON, delimiter ordering, and token/event ordering (OpenAI compat)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: We continue to see customer reports and internal fuzzing that streaming responses over SSE can produce malformed partial JSON payloads for structured outputs and break tool/function-calling consumption in OpenAI-compatible clients. Root causes: 1) chunk boundary logic occasionally emitted event delimiters in the wrong order when partial JSON tokens spanned multiple chunks, 2) the SSE framing code buffered and emitted "data:" lines without preserving original event token ordering when batching, and 3) compatibility layer reformatting sometimes inserted extra delimiters when switching between text/event-stream and OpenAI-style delta messages. This PR fixes chunking/framing logic to guarantee deterministic ordering of token events and delimiters, adds stricter partial-JSON reassembly rules for structured outputs, and updates the OpenAI compatibility shim to avoid injecting extra separators. Changes: updated sse/framer to preserve token order and to always flush incomplete JSON tokens as a single atomic logical fragment; added a reassembly pass that detects and reorders partial JSON fragments when closing braces are received; added tests that reproduce previously-reported cases (partial JSON across chunks, delimiter ordering races, and mixed-mode streaming where both event and delta messages coexist); updated compatibility adapter to stop transforming empty events into separator-only frames. Impact: fixes customer-visible breakage for tool/function-calling and structured output consumers, reduces incidents seen in canaries, and removes a small class of malformed events observed in the OpenAI-compat tests. See testing and CI for details.

release_notes: Fixes SSE streaming chunking and framing bugs causing partial JSON and delimiter ordering issues. Restores deterministic token/event ordering for structured output and OpenAI-compatible streaming; should resolve failures in tool/function-calling clients.
notes_internal: Rollout: merged to main on 2026-02-18. Short-term: monitor sse_canary and openai_compat_integration dashboards for increases in 4xx/parse-errors. Ops: no DB or migration required. Backport: patch to release/2026-02 planned if canary shows regressions.
safety_and_testing: Added deterministic unit tests and fuzz cases that previously surfaced the bug. Canary run showed no regression in latency and reduced parse-error metric by ~88% on synthetic repro cases.
repro_steps: 1) Start a server with the compatibility shim enabled. 2) Stream a structured JSON response that intentionally splits a nested JSON object across multiple small chunks. 3) Observe previously malformed partial JSON or extra delimiter events in the client. The tests in tests/sse_partial_json_test.go reproduce this scenario programmatically.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on sse/reassembly.go and compat/openai_shim.go for correctness and edge cases where clients may expect legacy framing behavior. Performance notes are in the PR CI logs.
